mission: Broad non-P0 swarm: make heartbeat repository-skill provenance current-tree-grounded without racing the unresolved deep-detail owner request.

frontsAdvanced.result: Added standard-library current-tree skill discovery/hash and generated-index VERIFIED_CURRENT / STALE / UNRESOLVED classification with fail-closed strict mode.
Added runner-stable fixtures for current-tree discovery, repo-relative index resolution, foreign head, dirty/unknown cleanliness, stale/future timestamps, and missing clean-tree declaration.
Added repository doctrine that direct current-tree SKILL.md existence/hash outranks cached/generated skill indexes and preserves source/test/runtime/phone state separation.

Added DOM + inline-SVG Warm Wall for VERIFIED CURRENT / STALE INDEX / UNRESOLVED using radio semantics, roving keyboard focus, >=48px controls, one detail surface, reduced-motion support, and explicit source-only scars.
Caught five concrete source defects and recorded PASS only for bounded source/readback; TESTED remains false.
Pre-plan PLAN_ALLOWED and completion SOURCE_SLICE_STOP_ALLOWED; campaign remains CONTINUE_REQUIRED.
Authenticated owner readback remains legacy blob c266e66a... with setMaxLines(5) + END ellipsis. No owner mutation this pulse; prior unresolved Computer Hands request was not raced.
